terms.why: "One scrolling brand experience" built in Nordstrom's CMS with HTML/CSS/JS; screenshots show the live hero and scroll pages.
Page "had to be the store" — frames carry "SHOP THE COLLECTION", "SHOP THE LOOK" and a leggings product detail with rise/length specs.
Declares Campaign Design; assets grid frame shows the launch rolled across banners, social and signage.
Creative direction of supplied photography — "everything else was open: typography, layout, copy, animation, interaction."
"Typography at Volume" — big type, mixed weights, baselines off the grid; "CONFIDENCE IS STRENGTH" set across the hero frames.
Polygon "rotated slowly on scroll" via CSS transform, plus motion studies and animated polygon mask components.
"Launch emails timed to the drop" with the polygon running into the email headers.
"In-store signage for the locations carrying the line"; ivy-signage.jpg shows the backlit lightbox poster reading "CONFIDENCE IS STRENGTH".
Three collections of tableware repeats — 'amber-shockey-co-blue-florals-peony-wallpaper-pattern-field.jpg' shows the peony repeat at field size

'Every pattern had to work next to every other one' — hero/secondary/accent per collection on a shared cream ground, with a construction-grid system mark frame
"A.R.C., an iPhone app I designed and built for home inventory"; frames like arc-five-screen-app-showcase.png show the phone screens.
OpenAI Vision API and Perceptron Mk1 recognition; arc-pipeline-cloud-sync-step.jpg reads "Analyzing your photos with AI... 88%".
Declares Product Design and designs the whole flow — capture, review, gap analysis — seen in arc-ui-report-configuration-pdf.jpg and arc-dashboard-screen-hero.png.
"Full-Stack Engineering" — Python backend, Streamlit frontend, Supabase, deployed on Vercel, built solo end to end.
"brand had to make documenting your house something you might want to do" plus chromatic-brand-circle.png with palette hexes and roles.
arc-logo-grid.png shows the "a.r.c. / archive ready cloud" wordmark on a construction grid with circle and diagonal guides.
Prose: "Photographs from a family trip through far West Texas" shot on a Fuji X-T30; every frame is a landscape photograph.
Three lithographs built from letterforms — Didone serifs, calligraphic swashes, slab capitals — each stroke given a different fill ('the fancy' poster flat).
Twelve repeating tiles drawn positive and negative; the catalogue lists a dozen swatch frames (diamond grid, halftone dots, diagonal stripes).
'Three lithographs. Black ink on white paper' — posters shown printed and photographed on a bench and gate.
'the only decisions left were placement and scale' — the study governs ink-to-paper ratio and tile scale across all three sheets.
"Five logos for five clients" plus logo frames: spear COLLECTIVE vines, DJ MIA halftone, OKINA orbit wordmark, J. CHRISTIANSON four-circle mark.
Identity work made to fit each client — a fashion collective, a DJ, a lifestyle brand — wordmarks and marks like "hey! SD" and "inna".
Album sleeves, gig posters and art prints; framed poster mockups like "CANDY PAINT" and "Your Reflection Is Me".
"hand-drawn type where a piece called for it" and the ABC-123 typography exercise poster with dot-matrix letterforms.
"The photograph was shot on film and blown up to street size" — the bokeh source photograph frame is the work itself.
"one 4x6 film photograph blown up to fill a storefront window"; the Bokeh's Fall frame shows a backlit poster in a shopfront.
"Brand identity for Capitan Boot Co." — primary logo, badges, lockups built to survive stamping and embossing.
Bull skull lockup on a geometric grid plus buffalo and diamond badges in buffalo-logo.png and the four-up mark frame.
"Northwest Regular and Oldman Regular are the type pairing" with letterspaced wordmarks shown in the palette/grid frame.
"apparel graphics" declared and "stitched into denim... shows up on packaging and apparel".
"The campaign was shot in West Texas... The same person drew the marks and shot the pictures" — the landscape frames are the work.
"a campaign shot in West Texas" with lockups sitting on the Big Bend photographs.
"Took it down to the studs" — full interior rebuild with pine floors, painted stone wall, kitchen and A-frame ceiling shown in the chalet interior frames.

"Each frame defined what a good Cosmo Prof picture looks like" — compositions that read at thumbnail and full bleed.

"tabbed recommendations personalized to each stylist" and "The tabs sort to whoever is logged in."

"Next.js on Vercel, OAuth 2.0 consent with short-lived tokens" and a deterministic booking engine built end to end
"a brand that matched where the gym was headed": black/white palette, wordmark and interlocking monogram mark in dsc-owner-console-home-booking-requests

Prose declares "Interior design, furniture curation, finish selection" for a two-story foyer; photos show the finished entry with rug, chandelier, bench.
"The rug, the bench and the two pieces of art, all found" — vintage furniture curation and finish specification.

Three residential bathrooms designed floor to ceiling — 'urban southwest, exposed brick and a matte black soaking tub' — photographed as finished rooms.
Declares 'Material Selection, Finish Coordination' — marble, dolomite, white oak and tile picked together on one moodboard, mapped across three projects.
Prose: 400 sq ft primary bath designed with three marbles, two vanities, freestanding tub under a wood plank ceiling; frames show the finished room.
Scope names 'fixture sourcing, art selection, furniture curation' — 'None of it came from one vendor,' valet stand from an antique shop, vintage rugs.
Ground-up kitchen: space planning, cabinetry, material spec — frames like hill-country-kitchen-full-view-beams-runner-island.jpg show the finished room.
Declares "Fixture Selection" and mixes eras — antique cremone bolts, schoolhouse pendants, leather safari chairs, vintage runner — selected to one four-material palette.
"Living room around a floor-to-ceiling limestone fireplace wall, open to the kitchen" with material specification in AutoCAD/SketchUp, shown in the wide fireplace-wall frames.
Scope names "furniture curation, art selection, fixture sourcing" — the ladder shelf, brass fire tools and gilt-framed paintings frames show the collected pieces.
"The same idea runs on billboards, print, and digital, sized for each" — banner, posters, wallpaper, shirt.
